column1: # Spanish names for the stars page and the pass pages (SPEC FR-STAR-10 as amended v2.5, V25-16; FR-NAME-1, V214-8).
# con: key is the IAU abbreviation, part is the figure's part (Serpens has two, plus "all" for its one name in the Among column); every one of the 88 has a row.

# star: key is the IAU WGSN name as catalog.json carries it; every one of the 289 named stars has a row, its established Spanish form or "=" where Spanish usage keeps the IAU name. The build fails on a missing row (D-832, widened).
# The comment above each star row is the reviewer's note: the es.wikipedia title found, or why a form was not taken. Reviewed 2026-11-04 in P10 for the owner's spot-check.
# source const: the standard Spanish constellation names, es.wikipedia "Anexo:Constelaciones", https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anexo:Constelaciones, written 2026-10-25
# source eswiki: title (or lead sentence) of the star's Spanish Wikipedia article, resolved through redirects via the MediaWiki API, https://es.wikipedia.org/w/api.php, accessed 2026-11-04

# source eswiki-lead: Spanish form given as an alternative name in the first sentence of the star's Spanish Wikipedia article (title keeps the Latin/IAU spelling), https://es.wikipedia.org/w/api.php, accessed 2026-11-04
# source wikidata: Spanish (es) label of the star's Wikidata item, https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php?action=wbgetentities, accessed 2026-11-04
# source iau: no Spanish article or label found; IAU WGSN name kept by default, https://www.iau.org/public/themes/naming_stars/, accessed 2026-11-04
